hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2080 Ti, standalone CUDA
notes: Latency fields ending in _ms are milliseconds. Submit, admission, first/last visible and done are offsets from the first client. Each serial control has its own origin.
Aggregate output rate includes queue, prefill and generation. The p95 is the nearest-rank gap within a stream of at least 20 visible text gaps. FiFi can emit multiple tokens per text update.

There is one observation per order and depth in the main sweep. Some host verification ran concurrently. GPU samples cover part of the first 64K cold prefill and the second 64K cold prefill. High GPU activity measures time with active kernels.
